prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1025; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Nothing independent confirms the accident: no witnesses, no photos and no other report.
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: On arrival at the signalized intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I found a side-impact collision between the vehicle operated by Driver 1 and the vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported a knee injury and was taken for evaluation, but it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this collision. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle, and both officers and bystanders who spoke with me confirmed this. No independent witness has come forward to describe how the collision happened, no photographs of the scene have been submitted, and no other report has been located. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle sits on a different side and at a different height from the impact Driver 1 described, which does not fit that account. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. Driver 1 lives with the policyholder of the insured vehicle and is listed as a household member.
